nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender in constructor and reassigned in acceptOwnership.
Pending new owner address; written by transferOwnership and cleared in acceptOwnership.
ERC20 token symbol ('1SA') set in the FirstSaudiToken constructor.
ERC20 token name set in the FirstSaudiToken constructor.
Token decimals (18) set in the FirstSaudiToken constructor.
Total token supply, minted to the deployer address in the constructor.
mapping(address => uint) of token balances; written by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) written by approve and approveAndCall, decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender: caller identity used for ownership checks and balance/allowance keying.
SafeMath.safeAdd(uint a, uint b): addition with overflow require(c >= a).
SafeMath.safeSub(uint a, uint b): subtraction with require(b <= a).
SafeMath.safeMul(uint a, uint b): multiplication with overflow require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath.safeDiv(uint a, uint b): division with require(b > 0).
Owned constructor: sets owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner): onlyOwner; stages a new owner in newOwner.
acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner then moves owner to newOwner and clears newOwner.
FirstSaudiToken constructor: sets metadata and mints the whole supply to a hardcoded address.
totalSupply(): returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)].
balanceOf(address tokenOwner): reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens): safeSub from msg.sender, safeAdd to recipient, emits Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens): sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens): decrements balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender], credits to.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender): reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data): sets allowance then calls spender.receiveApproval.
Fallback function: payable, immediately reverts so the token never accepts ETH.
transferAnyERC20Token(address tokenAddress, uint tokens): onlyOwner; calls arbitrary ERC20 transfer.
Arithmetic subtraction of tokens from balances[msg.sender] inside transfer (relies on safeSub require).
Arithmetic addition of tokens to balances[to] inside transfer (relies on safeAdd require).
Arithmetic subtraction from balances[from] and allowed[from][msg.sender] inside transferFrom.
Arithmetic addition of tokens to balances[to] inside transferFrom.
External call to attacker-supplied spender contract receiveApproval() after allowance state write in approveAndCall.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to an arbitrary caller-supplied contract.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable, granting privileged rights to the caller.
Owned constructor writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner modifier reads owner to authorise transferOwnership.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
Parameter _newOwner is consumed by transferOwnership.
Parameter _newOwner is stored into the newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner to validate the caller.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the name state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed 1e26 value.
Constructor credits the entire supply to a hardcoded address in the balances mapping.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)].
balanceOf uses its tokenOwner argument to index balances.
balanceOf returns the value read from the balances mapping.
transfer uses the to parameter as credit recipient.
transfer uses the tokens parameter as transfer amount.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
transfer indexes balances with msg.sender as the debited account.
transfer invokes safeSub on balances[msg.sender].
tokens parameter is the subtrahend in the balance decrement.
Result of the subtraction is written back to balances[msg.sender].
transfer invokes safeAdd on balances[to].
to parameter determines which balance entry is incremented.
tokens parameter is the addend in the balance increment.
Result of the addition is written back to balances[to].
transfer delegates the subtraction to SafeMath.safeSub.
transfer delegates the addition to SafeMath.safeAdd.
approve uses the spender parameter as allowance key.
approve uses the tokens parameter as the allowance value.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
msg.sender keys the first dimension of the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses the from parameter as the debited account.
transferFrom uses the to parameter as the credited account.
transferFrom uses the tokens parameter as the transfer amount.
transferFrom invokes safeSub on balances[from] and on the spender allowance.
tokens parameter is the subtrahend in both decrements of transferFrom.
Subtraction result is written back to balances[from].
Subtraction result is written back to allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom invokes safeAdd on balances[to].
Addition result is written back to balances[to].
transferFrom delegates subtractions to SafeMath.safeSub.
transferFrom delegates addition to SafeMath.safeAdd.
allowance uses tokenOwner as the first mapping key.
allowance uses spender as the second mapping key.
allowance returns the value read from the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall uses spender both as allowance key and as the callee address.
approveAndCall uses tokens as the allowance and forwarded amount.
approveAndCall forwards the data parameter to the callee.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into the spender contract after the allowance write.
Caller-supplied spender address controls the target contract of the external call.
msg.sender is passed as the from argument to receiveApproval.
The spender contract may re-enter the token during receiveApproval (callback path).
transferAnyERC20Token uses tokenAddress as the external contract to call.
transferAnyERC20Token uses tokens as the amount forwarded.
onlyOwner reads owner to authorise transferAnyERC20Token.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner before the external token transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to a caller-supplied contract address.
tokenAddress parameter fully controls the callee of the external call.
The external transfer moves the recovered tokens to the owner address.

Parameter b is only meaningful inside safeAdd, where it is used as the second addition operand.
Parameter a is only meaningful inside safeSub, where it is used as the minuend.
Parameter b is only meaningful inside safeSub, where it is used as the subtrahend.
Parameter a is only meaningful inside safeMul, where it is used as the first multiplication operand.
Parameter b is only meaningful inside safeMul, where it is used as the second multiplication operand.
Parameter a is only meaningful inside safeDiv, where it is used as the numerator.
Parameter b is only meaningful inside safeDiv, where it is used as the denominator.
